5 · minimal — for essays, where a wall of cards would cheapen the ending

Geometry, not decoration

All five keep YouTube's element geometry: two 16:9 slots and one circular subscribe target, none within 6% of an edge. The dashed regions are holes for the platform's own UI — mark them, don't decorate them.
